regime_context: The detector shows broad eligible leadership (8/16 themes) with two clear momentum leaders — Oil & Gas Producers and Gold Miners — but one_narrative is false, directionality is absent, and cross-sectional momentum is a focus lens with no forward edge. The absolute-trend gate is the only validated leg and gate_helps is true, backing a risk-control framing. The macro_narrative sample is too thin (n=1) and fully unscheduled, so it provides no useful regime read.
emerging_watch: Pipelines & Midstream: it is ranked 6th (score 0.14) with high durability (0.68) and a 'trend' hurst tag, but no scorable ETF. I am watching for a confirmed leadership handoff only if an observable proxy (or its constituents as a group) climbs into the top-3 momentum rank while staying trend-gated eligible for two consecutive weeks — that would retire this watch.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The detector ranks Oil & Gas Producers as the clear leader (rank 1, score well ahead of Gold Miners) with the strongest breadth of any theme (0.786) and an eligible trend gate. This combination of breadth plus trend-gate eligibility is the one leg that has shown risk-control value; however, the theme is crowded (z 1.04, crowded true), so it carries continuation risk and the edge is only in reduced drawdown behavior, not higher returns.
evidence: crowded true (z 1.04) — a sizing caution, not a reason to fade
theses.dissent: The theme is crowded and hurst is mixed, meaning the leadership is partly reflexive attention rather than durable trend; a profit-taking shake-out could hit the crowded leader hardest, and the detector has no basket-level drawdown edge from crowding/extension.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX benchmark by 5% or more before 2026-11-05.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the clear challenger (rank 2, score 1.11) with eligible trend-gate status and is NOT crowded (crowding_z 0.2), which makes it a cleaner participation candidate than the crowded leader. However, its breadth is very narrow (0.267) and hurst is mixed, signaling the move is not yet broad-based.
evidence: challenger in rotation structure, margin 0.502 below leader
theses.dissent: Breadth of only 0.267 means the theme is carried by a handful of names and is fragile to single-stock blowups; the detector shows no basket drawdown edge for extension, so the narrow leadership is a vulnerability, not a strength.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX benchmark by 5% before 2026-10-29.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the only theme with a clean 'trend' hurst tag, eligible trend-gate status, and neutral crowding (z -0.01), giving it the best staying-power profile among non-crowded eligible names. Its score is modest (0.423) and breadth thin (0.143), so the trend is narrow but mechanically the cleanest.
evidence: hurst_tag 'trend' — only trend cleanly trending theme among eligible ranks
theses.dissent: Thin breadth (0.143) means the trend rests on few names and could break fast; the modest momentum score does not distinguish it strongly from laggards, and financials can be highly sensitive to a single macro shock that the detector cannot foresee.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags the S&P/TSX benchmark by 5% before 2026-11-20.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
